The Supreme Court this week suspended life sentences of two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case and granted them bail.
Episode 1938 looks at the 2002 Bilkis Bano case, and its long course. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains the many twists, turns, what the order means & what it doesn’t.
